collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BELIEF, IDENTITY AND PERSONAL EXPRESSION (BLF-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Religious, spiritual, atheist, agnostic, questioning and simply uninterested villagers living side by side; who people are, whom they love and how they present themselves. Privacy is respected, nobody has to explain or justify anything, and differences don't have to be the subject. Gods and spirits stay unconfirmed either way.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A couple ask the leader of the village songs for a blessing: the leader says yes at once, or asks what they would like.

setup_m.name: The setup
setup_m.text: (men1) and (men2) have been together for a while, and they'd like a blessing from (third), who leads the village's songs. They're both a bit nervous asking. (third) listens to them, then smiles.

o2_m.name: Outcome B
o2_m.text: "What sort of blessing would you like?" asks (third). "Big? Small? Old words or new ones?" The couple look at each other, relieved. "Small," says (men1). "Old words," says (men2). "With fish," they both add. (third) laughs. It's small, with old words and a great deal of fish, and exactly what they wanted.

o2_f.text: "What sort of blessing would you like?" asks (third). "Big? Small? Old words or new ones?" The couple look at each other, relieved. "Small," says (women1). "Old words," says (women2). "With fish," they both add. (third) laughs. It's small, with old words and a great deal of fish, and exactly what they wanted.

o1_m__fx.name: Outcome A
o1_m__fx.text: "Of course," says (third). "I'd be honored." The blessing is small and simple, by the sea at sunset, with a few friends and a lot of flowers. (third) says the old words. (men1) and (men2) hold hands the whole time, trying not to cry and both failing. Afterwards, everyone eats far too much. It's a very good evening.
